name: zeri-mcp-workspace
description: Workspace root for shunshi-zeri-core (Chinese date selection engine) and shunshi-zeri-mcp (MCP server wrapper).
_comment_overrides: Local development only: points the cross-repo dependency at the sibling bazi-reader-mcp checkout so both repos can be worked on together. Run `npm run build` there first — this links the built package, not the sources. NOTE the path carries one extra `../`: npm resolves a workspace-root override relative to a workspace package directory, then writes the symlink relative to node_modules. This file is private and never published; consumers install shunshi-bazi-core from npm.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shunshi-zeri-core && npm run build -w shunshi-zeri-mcp
